description: Target or untarget one video or audio track for source-patched insert/overwrite edits. Premiere allows several tracks of a type to be targeted at once, so by default (exclusive=true) targeting a track also untargets every other track of the same type. Reads back every track of that type and reports verified only when the readback matches the requested state; otherwise committed_unverified or an error.

exclusive.description: When targeting (targeted=true), also untarget every other track of the same type so only this track is targeted (default: true). Ignored when targeted=false.

targeted.description: Whether to target (true) or untarget (false) the track

name: set_target_track

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Target Track
